race.comment: LIVE (6) is an intriguing runner resuming and making her stable debut for the Snowden camp. She's tackled much stronger company than this to date and has had excuses throughout. Has impressed in her lead-up work and can make a bright return. CAFE AU LAIT (4) was well supported first up when just missing. She's sure to have come on from that and keeps JMac. Deserves obvious respect. SPHERE (11) led pillar-to-post fresh when justifying the very short quote. Went amiss at Rosehill in a strong form race but got things back on track last time. Has more to offer. REGAL PROBLEM (7) made light work of her rivals first up at Gosford. Improvement to come and looks a genuine threat.
